commands.label: gitleaks
commands.shell_command: echo 'security-lane:gitleaks:start' >&2; if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then scan_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$scan_dir"' EXIT; git archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -xf - -C "$scan_dir"; (cd "$scan_dir" && gitleaks detect --no-git --source . --config .gitleaks.toml --gitleaks-ignore-path .gitleaksignore --redact --no-banner); else gitleaks detect --no-git --source . --config .gitleaks.toml --gitleaks-ignore-path .gitleaksignore --redact --no-banner; fi; status=$?; echo 'security-lane:gitleaks:done' >&2; exit $status

commands.label: cargo-audit
commands.shell_command: db="${JANKURAI_CARGO_AUDIT_DB:-target/jankurai/security/advisory-db}"; offline="${JANKURAI_SECURITY_OFFLINE:-${CARGO_NET_OFFLINE:-false}}"; case "$offline" in 1|true|TRUE) [ -d "$db" ] || { echo "offline advisory database missing: $db" >&2; exit 1; } ;; *) if [ -d "$db/.git" ]; then git -C "$db" pull --ff-only --depth 1; else git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db.git "$db"; fi ;; esac; cargo audit --db "$db" --no-fetch --stale
